rules.title: No Synthetic Historical L2 Depth
rules.requirement: Gate G1 remains fail-closed until continuous verified L2 order-book tapes exist.

rules.title: No Fabricated Maker Fills
rules.requirement: Synthetic or predefined historical maker fills are permanently banned under WP-8S.

rules.title: Point-in-Time Evidence Cutoff
rules.requirement: All underwriting inputs must precede the PIT cutoff timestamp; zero lookahead leakage.

rules.title: Conditional EV Non-Double-Counting
rules.requirement: EV_fill = E[Payoff | Fill] - Price - Effective_Fees; adverse selection enters via fill-conditioned win rate only.

rules.title: Positive Net Edge Hurdle
rules.requirement: Candidates with non-positive conditional EV after fees are rejected fail-closed.

rules.title: Finite Order Lifecycle
rules.requirement: Orders may only occupy states in Candidate -> Prepared -> Resting -> Filled/Cancelled/Raced -> Settled -> Ledger.

rules.title: No Skipped or Backward Transitions
rules.requirement: Lifecycle transitions must follow the directed acyclic transition table without backward hops.

rules.title: Terminal State Immutability
rules.requirement: Ledger and terminal Cancelled/Raced states are immutable once recorded.

rules.title: Overfill Cap Enforcement
rules.requirement: Cumulative filled_qty must never exceed reserved_qty.

rules.title: Pre-Event Calendar Blackouts
rules.requirement: Calendar-driven quote cancellations replace sub-millisecond HFT race simulations.

rules.title: Strategy D Passive Maker Posture
rules.requirement: Maker limit orders serve strictly as fee-avoidance tactics, never speculative latency chasing.

rules.title: ADR-008 Integer-Cent Conservation
rules.requirement: All monetary amounts are 64-bit integer cents; floating-point currency is prohibited.

rules.title: 87/10/3 Waterfall Truncation & Residual
rules.requirement: Positive Net PnL floor-truncates 87% SCMA and 3% FAEP; CFCP receives 10% plus every residual cent.

rules.title: Loss Isolation Boundary Reconciliation
rules.requirement: Reconcile 100% SCMA loss isolation covenant vs. Oct 20 docket note referencing CFCP loss absorption.

rules.title: 40% Dry-Powder Cash Floor
rules.requirement: Unreserved liquid cash must remain at or above max(4000 cents, 40% of equity).

rules.title: Quarter-Kelly Ceiling
rules.requirement: Single-trade risk sizing is hard-capped at 200 bps (2.00%) Quarter-Kelly ceiling.

rules.title: Downward-Only Member Risk Dial
rules.requirement: Members may lower risk autonomously; upward restoration requires F2-H custodian approval.

rules.title: N=12 Concurrency & Priority Eviction
rules.requirement: Active admitted slots are capped at N=12 with deterministic rank-based eviction.

rules.title: Cross-Account Contract Mutex
rules.requirement: ContractMutexRegistry enforces anti-collusion domain/contract locks per CFTC Rule 150.4.

rules.title: $25k Active Float Ceiling Sweep
rules.requirement: Custodial balances above 2,500,000 cents stage signed IF-038 outbox sweeps.

rules.title: ADR-011 Air-Gapped Banking Boundary
rules.requirement: Zero bank account numbers, routing numbers, or plaintext venue secrets stored on disk.

rules.title: Signed Monotonic Outbox Sequencing
rules.requirement: Every outbox envelope carries a monotonic sequence ID and HMAC-SHA256 signature.

rules.title: Directive R-06 Active-Hat Siloing
rules.requirement: Role tokens are strictly siloed; cross-role endpoint access fails closed with HTTP 403.

rules.title: Directive R-12 Telemetry Redaction
rules.requirement: Technical console masks financial fields by default until an expiring CA grant is active.

rules.title: Directive R-15 Distribution Gateway
rules.requirement: Green is autonomous, Yellow adds friction, Red enforces 24-hour lock and dual F2-H co-signing.

rules.title: Directive R-04 Fail-Closed Emergency Halt
rules.requirement: Emergency kill-switch halts new commitments immediately; AI never executes unilaterally.
